coordinates.note: Geocode of the general ORM campus area per A23; both the MAGIC telescopes and CTAO-North's telescopes (including the LST-1 prototype) sit within this observatory but at their own distinct points a few hundred metres apart. No source fetched this session gave separate decimal coordinates for the MAGIC pads versus the CTAO-North array, so both experiments' detector records place at this single shared, approximate point rather than inventing a distinction.

summary.plain: The mountaintop area on La Palma, Spain, where both the MAGIC telescopes and the northern half of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory stand.
summary.technical: Shared approximate site for gamma-ray telescopes at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, La Palma, Canary Islands, Spain; hosts MAGIC and CTAO-North.
